title: Data Engineering for AI Systems
summary: Build trustworthy data and knowledge pipelines: source contracts, idempotent ingestion, lineage, quality, labeling, feedback, and lifecycle operations.
outcomes: Design batch, event, and change-data ingestion with explicit source contracts and provenance
Build idempotent, observable pipelines with data-quality gates and versioned datasets
Create labeling and feedback workflows that control bias and reviewer disagreement
Operate features and knowledge sources for freshness, permissions, correction, and deletion

lessons.title: From source systems to trustworthy datasets
Reliable pipelines, quality gates, and lineage
Labels, review operations, and feedback loops
